governing_goal: Make native ChatGPT sessions proactively and independently route every selected-context request to the appropriate UAOS execution depth without requiring the user to classify the task, while keeping Custom Instructions bootstrap-only and preserving the explicit boundary that native ChatGPT is not a repository-controlled non-bypassable runtime.
observed_gap: The current session policy makes lightweight problem detection always-on, but does not define an equally explicit every-turn execution-depth routing responsibility for non-problem research/design/decision work.

The current ChatGPT Custom Instructions pointer tells the model to activate cognition on problems/corrections/knowledge gaps, but does not explicitly require independent DeepTask semantic assessment for every request.

DeepTaskSignals and assess_deep_task_requirement already support semantic non-explicit escalation, so the missing layer is host/session invocation responsibility rather than a new DeepTask state machine.

architecture_candidates.reason: Leaves the user responsible for noticing when a non-problem task needs deeper execution.
Creates a stale shadow policy, prompt bloat and drift from repository authority.
Duplicates the existing deliberation/DeepTask authority and adds unnecessary architecture.
Adds the missing every-turn invocation responsibility at the session/host layer while leaving DeepTask semantics and evidence admission in their existing canonical owners.

external_method_evidence: OpenAI Help Center: Custom Instructions are direct guidance that is applied across chats, making them suitable for a compact bootstrap/activation pointer rather than duplicated policy authority.
OpenAI Help Center: Memory uses relevant context rather than every historical detail on every response, so Memory alone is not an adequate deterministic bootstrap substitute.
Existing UAOS architecture principle: policy ownership remains singular; session/host surfaces activate and report canonical cognition rather than redefining it.
planned_changes: Add an always-on lightweight execution-depth sentinel to config/SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY.json that independently derives DeepTask semantic signals on every selected-context turn and treats explicit user depth as an override rather than the only trigger.

Update docs/integration/CHATGPT_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md so the recommended pointer requires independent task-depth assessment and proactive UAOS escalation without copying DeepTask evidence dimensions.
Update HOST_PROFILES.json and CURRENT_SYSTEM.json to describe the native ChatGPT self-classification path accurately while retaining the no-verified-pre-send/no-guaranteed-signal-injector boundary.
Add contract tests that reject user-dependent-only depth routing and reject policy duplication in the Custom Instructions pointer.
acceptance_criteria: Every selected-context turn has an explicit lightweight execution-depth routing responsibility independent of problem detection.
User wording is not required to identify complexity/systemic/architecture/depth; explicit depth language only forces escalation.
DeepTask semantics remain owned by DELIBERATION_POLICY and src/uaos/kernel/deep_task.py; no second cognition state machine is created.
Custom Instructions remain compact bootstrap/activation guidance and do not duplicate the A-H evidence profile.
Native ChatGPT physical complete mediation remains explicitly unclaimed.
Repository tests and promotion checks pass before production merge.
next_action: Implement candidate policy/bootstrap changes, add contract tests, open PR, run owner-appropriate checks, then promote and reread production if green.
